title: Anti-Reflective Coating Copay on Vision Plans Eyeglasses
content:
**Option copay — anti-reflective coating (Vision Plans eyeglasses orders)**

An anti-reflective copay is added when the lens options of the lens line list an anti-reflective coating.

| Lens options listed | Anti-reflective copay |
|---|---|
| Premium anti-reflective coating (whether or not the standard coating is also listed) | The plan's premium anti-reflective copay |
| Standard anti-reflective coating, without the premium coating | The plan's standard anti-reflective copay |
| Neither | Nothing (0.00) |

Copays by plan (USD):

| Plan | Standard anti-reflective | Premium anti-reflective |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Vision Exam Plus | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cascade Vision Essential 100 | 41.00 | 85.00 |
| Cascade Vision Select 130 | 41.00 | 85.00 |
| Cascade Vision Select 150 | 41.00 | 85.00 |
| Cascade Vision Choice 175 | 25.00 | 65.00 |
| Cascade Vision Premier 200 | 0.00 | 40.00 |

*Hypothetical cases on Cascade Vision Select 130.* Lenses with the premium coating carry an anti-reflective copay of 85.00; with the standard coating, 41.00; with no anti-reflective coating, 0.00. A lens line listing both coatings carries only the premium copay of 85.00.
